title: Allen Dulles arranged transfer of the Magenta object under Truman
summary: Harold Malmgren tells of Allen Dulles arranged transfer of the Magenta object under Truman, about 1940s at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: How did it end up that Truman transferred that that object from Italy? The steps getting there was arranged by Alan Dulles.

plain: Harold Malmgren, a former adviser to US presidents, told podcast host Jesse Michels about a strange object said to have been recovered in Magenta, Italy, in the 1940s, and later moved to the United States under President Harry Truman. Malmgren says the steps that got it there were arranged by Allen Dulles, an American intelligence official of that era. If true, it would mean the US quietly took possession of a crashed unknown craft before the famous cases of the late 1940s.
